data.name: Harshini
data.gender_notes: Harshini is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harshini is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘harsa’ (joy, delight) and ‘shini’ (shining, radiant). This beautiful name signifies a joyful and luminous being. The name Harshini carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harshini usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringing joy and light to the world.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harshini total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
